test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 103 678 217 111 537 (Right)

(Example: 697 - First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7) (Note: All operations to be done from left to right.)

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is added to the first digit of the lowest number?
solution:
The given three-digit numbers are: 103, 678, 217, 111, 537.

Now,

The highest number is 678. Its second digit is 7.

The lowest number is 103. Its first digit is 1.

Perform the addition.

Add the second digit of the highest number 7 to the first digit of the lowest number 1.

7 + 1 = 8.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
